name: Gusty 404
summary: A windy 404 page: swaying digits, a flapping laundry line and flying pages you can catch
about: A full 404 page where a live wind blows through everything. The 404 digits sway one after another, a kurta, dupatta and sock flap on a laundry line, leaves tumble and wind streaks race across the sky. Sweep the pointer to push the wind, press Make it gust for a big blast, and catch the three flying pages for a confetti finish.
how: The page drops in: digits fall into place, then the text and the laundry line rise up
A gentle breeze with random gusts sways the digits, flaps the clothes and turns the pinwheel in the zero
Sweep your mouse or finger across the sky to push the wind your way
Press Make it gust for a strong blast, or Calm the wind to let everything settle
Tap the three flying pages to catch them; catching all three throws confetti, and Release them starts again
Back to home and Go back lead visitors out, and the popular pages slide in as you scroll
